claim_card.coefficient_domain: Real finite-dimensional linear spaces; finite action and observation alphabets; arbitrary finite, possibly redundant normalized synthesis.
quantified_objects: Linear synthesis V, mass l, l composed with V equal to coefficient sum; V surjective for full base norm.
Actual stationary controlled operator/initial pair, and literal P37 population-table realization in the observable specialization.
Witness matrices for every action-observation symbol, nonnegative entries, normalized nonnegative initial coefficient vector, exact intertwining and per-action mass law.
Actual operator/initial uncertainty set, explicit measurable coverage event with probability lower bound 1-delta, robust witnesses for every member.
One common arbitrary randomized history-dependent policy; every finite horizon including zero.
Summed branch discrepancy on every point of the same certified normalized base and an initial base-norm error bound.
conclusions: Fitted witness gives an invariant finite probability domain, normalized initial, all-word probabilities, and actual normalized joint/observed laws at every horizon.
On the stipulated coverage event the true and fitted models share the certified domain, and joint and observation-only TV are bounded by min(1,(e0+sum epsilon)/2).
Conditioning either law on the same event has min(1,budget/true-event-mass) bound when both event masses are positive.
Exact invertible transport preserves the literal nonnegative finite certificate and all-word likelihoods.
Complete signed-packet synthesis preserves predictions; individual normalized packets are probability states only with separate cone positivity and positive mass.
boundary_cases: No finite horizon cutoff; word and record induction theorems cover every list/natural length, including empty word/horizon zero.
Redundant generator synthesis is permitted: no injectivity or pseudoinverse norm is assumed.
An empty coefficient index cannot support Witness.prior, so it cannot spuriously certify a normalized state.
Zero policy probabilities are permitted; no lower propensity condition is introduced.
Zero-mass positive packets vanish; normalized individual states require strictly positive packet mass.
No unrestricted confidence procedure, rank discovery, protocol validity, or coverage conclusion is inferred from algebraic fits.
